blocks.text: Load report: Lakeshore Memorial Day weekend sale

This is the working cut for LSH-TST-2024-037 on May 28, 2024. Greta Holm asked for a written bound after the current path (k6 on stg-inv, two API pods mirrored) stopped being honest. I am Michael Gilfilian, Web Developer, writing for Luis Ortega, Cole Brennan, and Mara Singh. Primary host stg-inv.lakeshore.internal. If you are skimming, jump the decision callout, then the refuse on 1x Tuesday soak as 'good enough', then open questions. If you are implementing next week, jump the constraints, the numbers table, and the commands or contracts.

Soak at 2.4x Tuesday for 45 minutes. Fail if p95 over 0.9s or error rate over 0.7 percent. Staging partition count matches prod. I am not restating a hallway yes. 1x Tuesday soak as 'good enough' is out because Last year 1x soak passed. Saturday died at 2.1x. Greta will not bless 1x again. Cost of doing nothing is already in the numbers: look at mult=2.4, mins=45, p95=0.9, err=0.7, last=2.1, weeks=1, pods=2, tuesday=0.42. Sibling tickets LSH-5355 and LSH-MEM-2024-022. I will not reopen 1x Tuesday soak as 'good enough' in a side thread because a vendor sent a discount. Cole Brennan is the acceptor unless the owners line says otherwise.
